title: Nepal operating hydropower registry — governed research storage manifest
authority: Department of Electricity Development (DoED), Government of Nepal
status_definition: A project is treated here as officially operating only when it appears in the current DoED Power Plants :: Hydro operating register. This is a source-backed administrative classification for research, not legal advice.

official_sources.coordinate_fields: DoED publishes latitude and longitude bounds/extents for projects in this register. These are project geographic extents, not guaranteed powerhouse points.

official_sources.category: Operating hydro plants on the DoED small-plant page
official_sources.coordinate_fields: Fourteen entries have non-zero published latitude/longitude bounds. Six entries explicitly publish 0°00′00″ coordinate fields and are not coordinate-admitted.

coordinate_policy.official_doed_extent: Admissible as a project geographic extent when all latitude/longitude fields are non-zero.
coordinate_policy.exact_point: A point marker may be labelled as a plant/powerhouse point only when a source explicitly publishes a point coordinate with that meaning.
coordinate_policy.derived_midpoint: A midpoint derived from a DoED extent may be stored only as a reference midpoint and must never be labelled as an exact powerhouse or dam coordinate.
coordinate_policy.zero_coordinate: 0°00′00″ fields are treated as missing coordinates and excluded from coordinate-qualified counts.

supplemental_coordinate_dataset.provider: Niti Foundation / NAXA Nepal Hydropower Portal
supplemental_coordinate_dataset.usage_rule: Use as a supplemental point-coordinate and project-reference dataset. Its license/status field is not treated as the current legal authority; current operating status must be reconciled against the 2026 DoED operating register before a record is promoted to the governed operating layer.

current_exact_point_subset.description: Ten major operating hydropower references currently shown on the map with project-specific point-coordinate provenance.

ingestion_state.reason: DoED's current operating register publishes project coordinate extents rather than guaranteed exact plant points. The research system will not fabricate exact points from those extents.
